mainEntity.name: How much does a custom deck usually cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom deck varies widely based on size, design complexity, material selection, and site preparation requirements. A basic deck might start around $30 per square foot, while more elaborate designs with premium materials can exceed $75 per square foot. Features like multi-level designs, built-in seating, railings, and lighting will increase the overall investment. We provide a detailed, itemized quote after an initial consultation, ensuring transparency regarding all project expenses.
